description: An athlete's fitness chart as numbers — what the plan's "Fitness & Form" card draws when opened in full: fitness (CTL), fatigue (ATL) and form (TSB) over a window, two weeks of projection from the planned sessions, the tiles (today's values and the 7-day ramp), the season's phase bands and the next race's outlook. Default window: four weeks back and two ahead, one point a day; ask for granularity "week" over a season. Use it when the question is how fitness is trending, not what happened in one session. Draws a page in the chat — "Fitness & form" — so the figures are on screen: refer to what the page shows rather than retyping it, and spend your words on what it means.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.
